tickets.title: Build shared inheritance tracking ledger
tickets.text: Create a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, received forms, ownership notes, and open questions for Nadia Thimblefern to discuss with Rowan.
tickets.evidence: Nadia asked for a shared tracking ledger for inherited accounts, estate contacts, forms received, ownership notes, and open questions so she can discuss the estate with Rowan using the same record set; they agreed to build it by 2024-02-23.

tickets.title: Upload probate authority paperwork
tickets.text: Upload the certified authority paperwork for Alden Thimblefern’s estate to the custodian and Teacup Comet Bank so the required documents are on the secure portal.
tickets.evidence: For probate authority documents, the estate attorney has provided death certificate copies, but the certified authority paperwork needed by the custodian and bank has not been uploaded to the secure portal; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-02-20.

tickets.title: Resolve estate bank access problem
tickets.text: Work with Teacup Comet Bank to correct the executor record mismatch and restore Nadia Thimblefern’s online estate‑account access.
tickets.evidence: Teacup Comet Bank rejected Nadia’s online estate-account access attempt and told her the executor record did not match its internal file, preventing her from viewing recent estate cash activity; the agreed follow-up on the estate bank access problem is due 2024-02-16.

tickets.title: Confirm IRA beneficiary percentages
tickets.text: Verify and correct the beneficiary percentage for Alden Thimblefern’s IRA, reconciling the paper copy with the custodian portal before signing inherited IRA paperwork.
tickets.evidence: For Alden’s IRA beneficiary percentage, Nadia brought a paper beneficiary copy that does not match the percentage shown in the custodian portal, and the controlling designation needs to be confirmed before inherited IRA paperwork is signed; follow-up is needed, with no date supplied.

tickets.title: Organize estate inventory and distribution details
tickets.text: Compile the estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distribution information for the CPA and estate attorney ahead of the next tax‑planning conversation.
tickets.evidence: The estate inventory, anticipated income items, and beneficiary distributions need to be organized for the CPA and estate attorney before the next tax-planning conversation tied to the estate administration calendar; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-01.

tickets.title: Update fiduciary role appointment
tickets.text: Amend the 2016 personal estate documents to replace the deceased Alden Thimblefern as successor fiduciary and reflect the current executor roles.
tickets.evidence: The planning review found the 2016 personal estate documents’ reference to Alden in a successor fiduciary role creates a stale appointment after his death; the agreed follow-up on the fiduciary role update is due 2024-03-08.

tickets.title: Design separate investment framework
tickets.text: Create a distinct investment and spending framework for inherited assets that supports retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and keeps estate proceeds separate from routine household spending.
tickets.evidence: Nadia wants a separate investment and spending framework for inherited assets that accounts for retirement flexibility, college costs, cash reserves, and her preference not to blend estate proceeds into routine spending immediately; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-03-15.
